title: orderapi's log went silent right after the last rotation
description_md:
The `orderapi` service runs as the unprivileged `orderapi` system account (it never runs as root). It's still handling requests fine, but `/var/log/orderapi/orderapi.log` hasn't grown at all since logrotate last rotated it -- the old entries from before the rotation are still there, nothing new. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), find out why the `orderapi` account can no longer write to its own log file, and fix it.

You're done when, after forcing a fresh logrotate run, the `orderapi` account can actually write a new line into the post-rotation log file.
